name: atlas-evaluation-content
title: AI Evaluation — reference knowledge
description: Portable, reusable reference knowledge for AI evaluation: benchmark cards (what each tests, how it scores, its metric, format, and known limitations/contamination), the underlying evaluation datasets and harnesses (lm-evaluation-harness, HELM, OpenAI Evals, LMArena, and more), and one score sheet per model listing its reported benchmark values with scale, source and date. Content only — Markdown + JSON Schema + docs, zero code.
